'Не медаль' is a steering claim: it does the job that card item 11 forbids 'рекомендую' from doing. (2) 'П2 лучше на столько же' is not true in general, because S2's loss min(i,|c+k|) has a different distribution. Also, P2 appears on the card only when exp75 is >= 0.955 and clean. (3) The sentence hardcodes exp85a, but the info row is <V_NONCI_FILE>, which can change after the 07:38-10:05Z reads (exp89p/exp89s; Q3 conditional l.44). (4) The prior CI P(>0) ~0.6 is at the pessimistic end: mc26 base N(+.0005,.0008) gives ~0.73, and probe 51 '+' came after it. S1 is therefore ~0.2-0.3, not 0.30. Feasibility is trivial (text only, 0 GPU, 0 Kaggle calls), but a text that contradicts the model rows two lines above it has slightly negative value.
